methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $15M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Chips & Semiconductors (found 0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 13 same-sector peers exist in Chips & Semiconductors, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

methods.name: Public-Comp Anchoring
methods.skip_reason: target revenue not on file (private companies rarely disclose)
methods.rationale: Public Semiconductors P/S median is 18.9x across 3 tickers. Cannot apply without target's revenue.

data.narrative:
Hyfix is a seed-stage semiconductor company founded by Mike Horton and Udan Ercan that has raised $15M to date. The Chips & Semiconductors sector contains 13 private peers and 3 public comparables (ALAB, NVDA, AMD), though the narrower seed-stage cohort is sparse.

Only one valuation method produced a reliable result. Stage-progression analysis, which applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yields $38M based on the $15M raised proxy. Peer-median valuation was not applicable: while 13 same-sector companies exist, fewer than three datapoints met narrow stage and tier filters necessary to avoid selection bias. Public-comp anchoring using the 18.9x P/S median across semiconductors peers cannot be executed without Hyfix's revenue figure, which private companies typically do not disclose.

The triangulated range is $32M–$43M, centered at $38M, supported by the stage-progression method alone. This narrow methodological foundation reflects a material constraint: the combination of seed-stage timing and frontier semiconductor focus limits direct peer density. Key uncertainties include burn rate, technical differentiation versus the identified private peer set (Cerebras, Credo, SambaNova, Etched, Ayar Labs), and path to meaningful revenue. A more robust valuation would require either disclosed financial metrics or an expanded set of seed-stage semiconductor comparables.
